title: Wayfeather trip data
description: Machine-readable mirror of DESIGN.md §3 (keep in lockstep). A trip file is one self-contained itinerary; index.json lists the trips the loader offers. For an LLM generating an itinerary: copy the shape of a fixture in data/trips/, obey the field notes below, and NEVER invent opening hours, coordinates, addresses, or confirmation details — leave hours as "" and set callAhead to true when hours are unverified. Real trips must never contain data that can't be public if the repo is public (no confirmation codes, no private stay addresses).

schema.description: Data-format version. The app refuses versions it doesn't know; bump only on breaking changes. Version 2 (2026-08-20) made `cost` a number.

id.description: Stable trip slug; matches the filename (<id>.json) and the id in index.json. Never regenerated on edit.

name.description: Human trip name shown in the Trips tab.

tz.description: IANA timezone the trip happens in, e.g. America/Chicago. Day-completion and 'today' logic use it.

base.description: Where you sleep — hotel, Airbnb, lodge. The header links it to Apple Maps.

address.description: Also supplies the locality used to synthesize search URLs ("City, ST").

lat.description: Filled by the geocode script (the base geocodes like any stopover; the map draws the Nest pin from it). Never invented by an LLM.

notes.description: Free-text banner shown in the footer (e.g. when hours were last verified).

days.description: Ordered. Every places[].day must match a days[].key. A day with date: null (conventionally key "bonus") is the unscheduled XTRA pool that feeds 'Find me something'.

places.description: Ordered chronologically within each day; the renderer groups by cluster in order of first appearance.

key.description: Short stable key places refer to, e.g. "fri", "bonus".

bullet.description: 1–2 character glyph for the day strip, e.g. "F", "+".

color.description: Legacy per-day color. Kept in data; the current UI uses a single app accent and ignores it.

darkText.description: Legacy hint that the color needs dark text. Optional; UI currently ignores it.

plan.description: Optional longer day-plan paragraph shown under the title on the day card; subtitle stays the one-liner.

place.description: A stopover (the UI's word for a place).

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the trip. Never regenerated on edit.

cluster.description: Walking-group heading, e.g. "Late AM — Chelsea". The reserved name "Inbox" holds quick captures not yet slotted.

time.description: Display time, free text: "3:00 PM", "~2:30 PM", "(optional)", "open", or "". Chronological slotting parses h:mm AM/PM where present.

type.description: Short category, free text: Food, Art, Books, Music, Stay, Drive, Walk, Sight, … "" allowed.

address.description: Street address, or "" (Drive legs, notes). Used for map/search links.

lat.description: Nullable; backfilled by the geocode script. NEVER invented by an LLM.

hours.description: Human-entered opening hours, e.g. "Mon–Sat 10–6", "Closed Tue; other days 10:30–5:30", "Daily 11–5; CLOSED Tue/Wed". NEVER invented — "" if unverified (pair with callAhead: true).

cost.description: Dollars as a number, as of schema 2. 0 means free; null means unknown, varies, or not applicable. Nuance that used to live in cost text ("pay-what-you-wish Wed 1:30–5:30", "StubHub credit", "cover varies") belongs in `notes`; a range migrates to its upper bound, which keeps the number budget-honest. Never a string — "$32" is not a cost, 32 is.

priority.description: How badly you want this, and nothing else — as of schema 2 the booked-ness and call-ahead axes moved to their own booleans. must = ★ Must chip. yes = the default, unmarked. maybe = the quiet Maybe chip. skip = kept but dimmed (also the soft-delete state). note = a row KIND rather than a want-level: renders as a text row with no links. Retired in schema 2: fixed → yes/must + reserved:true; maybe-not / if-close / optional → maybe; check → callAhead:true.

reserved.description: Booked or paid. Orthogonal to priority — a reserved stopover can be any want-level. The UI marks it with the ★★ Reserved chip (the loudest mark in the system) plus a reservation glyph beside the time, guards moves and skips behind one confirmation, and keeps it out of the Find-me-something pool.

callAhead.description: Hours are unverified, or the place wants a call first. Renders the ⚠ Call ahead line, merged with `warn` when both are set. Pair with hours: "" when an LLM could not verify opening times.

phone.description: Human-readable phone number, or "". Any format — the app normalises to digits for the tel: URL behind the Call tile. NEVER invented by an LLM.

website.description: Official URL or "". Yelp/Maps/Search links are synthesized from name + address when their fields are "".

warn.description: Red warning line, e.g. "Closed Mondays — your only Chelsea day". "" for none.

visited.description: Runtime state set by the Did it! button (ISO timestamp). LLMs generating itineraries leave it null or omit it.

skipped.description: Runtime state set by the Skip it button. A place is handled when either visited or skipped is set; visited wins for display.

index.description: data/trips/index.json — the trip loader's source of truth.

color.description: Legacy; unused by the current UI.
